name: Shadow · Knight style B (Wraith)
description: Kael as a wraith in the plumed Knight’s style: a slim assassin in a deep violet cowl and a long cloak whose hem tears into tongues that thin, dissolve and shed drifting flecks, with a scarf wound to the chin whose two tails stream back from his nape like the Knight’s plume, rippling and fraying at their ends. In the hood’s shadow a pale bone mask with one glowing moon-lilac eye. He walks on slim slate legs (no floating), a dagger forward in his near hand, another held low behind. As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted: indigo shadows, magenta-pink lights on the violet. The attack is a double throw: a crouch with the blades crossed, both arms cocked back over the shoulder, a pale-violet crescent swoosh over his head as they whip forward, then (frame 19) two daggers fly out with long glowing streaks, he spins back inside a ring of light and draws new blades. The eye, the blade edges and points and the streaks glow at night.
